chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin hih zaha tam teci pan’nate in ei hong uum ahih ciangin, eite in van khempeuh ahi zongin, hong bawlsia thei mawhna ahi zongin, paaikhia-in

eite upna a piangsakpa a kicingsakpa Zeisu a tel takin enin, i mai-ah a om kitaitehna-ah thakiamsak loin kidem ni. Tua Topa Zeisu in ama mai-ah a koih lungnopna thu hangin zumna ngaihsun loin, singlamteh a thuak khit ciangin Pasian’ tokhom ziat lamah a tu hi.
Thakiamna lungkiatna a om loh nadingin mawhna a nei mite kiangah tua zah khamna a thuak Topa ngaihsun un.
Note in mawhna khialhna tawh kido-in sisan suah dongin na thuak nai kei uh hi.
Tua tham loin: “Ka tapa aw, Topa’ thuhilhna ciamteh loin om kei in, na mawhna hong teldot ciangin lungkia kei in.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in a itte thu a hilh thei hi, a san’ a tate khempeuh a sat thei hi,” ci-in tate kiangah a cih bangin note hong kigen thuhilhna kam na mangngilh zo uh hi.
Note in thu hong hilh nading thuak un. Tate tungah kibawl bangin Pasian in note hong bawl hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a pa in a hilh loh ta kua mi ahi hiam?
Tate khempeuh in a thuak theih thuhilhna thuak lo na hih uh leh, ta taktak na hi kei ding uh hi, zawlta na hi ding uh hi.
Lam khat panin, pumpi tawh kipawl pate’ khut tungah eite in hilhna i thuak ciangin, amau i zahtak hi. Tua tham loin, khalam-a i Pa’ ukna thuakin nungta zaw ding hilo i hi hiam?

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua pate in a kilawm ci-in amaute ut bangin tawlkhat bek hong hilh uh hi. Pasian in a hih leh, ama siangthonate eite in i zop nadingin eite noptuamna ding ngaihsunin hong hilh hi.
Thuhilhna i thuak lai takin lungdamna-in kingaihsun loin dah nading bang kisa thei hi. Ahih hangin thulhilhna a thuak mite in a nung ciangin nopsakna ahi dikna gah a ngah uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thanem-a a om khutte leh tha a nei lo khukte na khauhsak un.
A khe zawte in a kilawi taktak loh nading, cidamna a ngah nadingin na paina lampi uh na tangsak un.
Mi khempeuh tawh kilemin nopsakna ahi zongin, a siangtho gamtatna ahi zongin na phak matengun delh un. Tua siangtho gamtatna a om kei leh, kuamah in Pasian a mu thei kei ding hi.
Note lakah khatpeuh mah in Pasian’ hehpihna thupha ngah loin a om loh nading ahi zongin, a kha kung a zung poin, note hong bawlsia-in mi tampi hong ninsak ding ahi zongin,
numei gilo tawh a mawhte a om loh nading ahi zongin, khatvei neek bek tawh ama ta upa-za a zuak Esau bangin Pasian’ thu a simmawh mi a om loh nadingin kikemin kidawm un.
Note in na theih uh mah bangin Esau in a nung ciangin a luah nop hangin nialna a ngah hi. Khitui luangin a zon’ hangin a pa’ lung kikheel nading thu a mu kei hi ci-in na thei uh hi.

Tua longal note in khut tawh a kilawng kha thei mei kang mualah ahi zongin, a vom meiipi-ah ahi zongin, khuamial ah ahi zongin, huihpi nungah ahi zongin, peengkul tumna aw-ah ahi zongin, kam awging ah ahi zongin a tung na hi kei uh hi. Tua aw a za mite in thu a piakkik loh nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Ganhing nangawn in tua mual a sukkhak leh, suang tawh kideeng lum ta hen,” ci-a thukhamna aw mite bil in a thuak zo kei uh hi.
Tua bang a kilatna in kihtakhuai mahmah ahih ciangin Moses in, “Keimah in kihta-in ka liing hi,” a ci hi.

Note in Zion Mual ah ahi zongin, a nungta Pasian’ khua ahi vantung Jerusalem khuapi-ah ahi zongin, a kisim zo lo vantungmi tampi kikhopna-ah ahi zongin, vantung lai sungah a kikhum ta-upa pawl a kikhoppina leh pawlpi-ah ahi zongin, mi khempeuh thu a khen ding Pasian kiangah ahi zongin, kicin’na ah a tung midik mite lungsim khate kiangah ahi zongin, thuciamna thak kikham ahi Zeisu kiangah ahi zongin, Abel’ sisan sangin a phazaw a kigen sisan kitheh kiangah ahi zongin, na tung uh hi.

Note in thu hong piapa’ kam na nial loh nadingun kikem un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitungah thu genkholhna hong pia mi’ kam a nial mi in mawhna tawh kipelh lo ahih leh, tua tham loin vantung pan thu hong pia kholpa kiang pan eite in pialkhia lehang, mawhna pan i suakta kei zawtham ding hi.
Tua lai takin a thu piakkholhna aw in leitung a liingsak hi. Tu-in ahih leh, “Khatvei keimah in lei tham loin, van nangawn ka liingsak kik ding hi,” cih kamciamna a om hi.
“Khatvei,” a cihna kam a khiatna in, a liing lo nate a kip nadingin a liing nate, a pian’sak nate a paaikhia ding hi a cihnopna hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite in a liing zo lo gam ngah i hih ciangin kihtakna zahtakna lungsim tawh Pasian a lungdamsak thei biakna na i sep zawh nadingin hong hehpihna lungsim nei ni.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, i Pasian in a kangtum thei mei ahi hi.
